title: Ox Passion Blueberry Pom Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Blueberry Pom blends the deep, juicy sweetness of ripe Blueberries with the rich, slightly tart notes of Pomegranate. The sweetness of plump, ripe blueberry fills each inhale with smooth, juicy flavour, while the pomegranate adds a subtly tangy depth that lingers long on the exhale. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, offering a smooth throat hit with well-balanced flavour. Ideal for pod vape kits and starter devices, it delivers rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
